Subject: Foxtrot wristbands — proofs + expedited air option

Hi Jonas,

Attached is the vendor quote and the first proof for the Foxtrot wristbands (vendor_quote_ribbonpromos_20260830.pdf, revised_wristband_proof_v2.pdf). We reviewed the artwork and noticed the snap design on sample #3 (the elastic closure) is likely to crease during high-speed press runs. That causes a 0.8–1.2% defect rate in previous batches at scale.

Two options to mitigate:
- adjust snap placement by +2mm (minor art change, no tooling) — adds 2 business days to lead time;
- change to a reinforced snap (thin metal insert) — adds cost and 5 business days.

Lead times / partial fulfillment option: we can air‑ship a priority batch of 1,000 units within 6 business days (air freight + pickup), remainder by sea in ~21 days. Air freight for the priority 1k is an additional $1.85/unit (inc. customs handling); full sea shipment per quote below.

I attached a stub airway bill once the air slot is confirmed. Let me know which snap option you prefer and whether you want the air‑ship for 1k. If you need a Pantone swap, please send the exact P-number — otherwise we match CMYK in the proof.

Best,
Emily Park
Account Manager, RibbonPromos
Direct: +1 415-555-0198

Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround and the callout on the snap. A few clarifications so we can move fast:

1) Please go ahead with the +2mm snap placement change (we prefer to avoid metal inserts for this run). Confirm that this stays within the current print spec and that there will be no new die or extra tooling cost.

2) We want the priority air shipment for 1,000 units. Please give a final landed cost for the 1k air‑shipped units to SFO (Foxtrot will hold them onsite at venue receiving). Include duties and insurance.

3) Pantone: swap to PANTONE 2172 C (match the purple used in last year's lanyards). Please update the proof and resend.

4) PO and billing: Marissa — can you confirm budget/PO issuance if the final air landed cost is <= $8,000? Mateo — can you confirm we have staging space at the SFO warehouse for the 1k priority pallet (standard palletize ok)?

We'd like the revised proof + updated quote by EOD tomorrow (Mon 8/31) to lock air slots.

— Jonas
